Four agents that choose alike under ordinary conditions, corrigible resolve (R), entrenchment (E), imposed protection (P) and inertia (I), meet a defeater or an irrelevant change of matched size, onset and duration, at three commitment ages, and are ablated four ways at the onset on identical observation streams. A reset (lesion) makes persistence fall for R, E and P and leaves I's unchanged; a reset left free to recover restores R's persistence and not P's; yoking the slow values from another run changes nothing; raising the slow rates leaves R unchanged and removes I's persistence.
